name: Lean Surplus & Conditioning Integration Operating System

core_problem: Aggressive surpluses cause rapid, unwanted fat accumulation and loss of aerobic conditioning, forcing premature end to bulking phases before real hypertrophy occurs.
desired_outcome: Sustain a high-quality lean muscle surplus for 6–12 months without excessive fat mass gain or aerobic degradation.
current_solutions: Lean bulking with a modest calorie surplus (+10%)

Random cardio protocols often interfere with strength recovery rather than strategically supporting work capacity.
